title: "Singletons"

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(here)
library(readr)

# ---- Define output dir inside the repository -------------------------------
out_dir <- here("results", "FigureSx_singletons")
dir.create(out_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

# ---- Load the data ---------------------------------------------------------
phage_results_path <- here("data", "results_with_metadata.csv")
phage_results <- read_csv(phage_results_path, show_col_types = FALSE)

# ---- Filter just infant samples --------------------------------------------
phage_results_infant <- phage_results %>%
  filter(mother_infant == "infant")

# ---- Count in how many infant samples each vOTU occurs ---------------------
# Presence defined as CPM > 0 (adjust if you prefer CPM >= 1, etc.)
votu_occurrence <- phage_results_infant %>%
  mutate(present = CPM > 0) %>%
  filter(present) %>%                              # keep only present pairs
  distinct(vOTUs, Sample) %>%                      # one presence per sample
  count(vOTUs, name = "n_samples")                 # number of samples per vOTU

# ---- Frequency distribution: X = n_samples, Y = number of vOTUs ------------
occurrence_freq <- votu_occurrence %>%
  count(n_samples, name = "n_vOTUs") %>%
  arrange(n_samples)

# (Optional) ensure missing x values appear as 0 bars
occurrence_freq <- occurrence_freq %>%
  complete(n_samples = 1:max(n_samples, na.rm = TRUE), fill = list(n_vOTUs = 0))

# ---- Plot ------------------------------------------------------------------
p_occurrence <- ggplot(occurrence_freq, aes(x = n_samples, y = n_vOTUs)) +
  geom_col(fill = "grey30") +
  labs(
    x = "Number of infant samples in which each vOTU is detected",
    y = "Number of vOTUs",
    title = "Frequency of vOTU occurrence across infant samples"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 16) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 18, hjust = 0.5),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 13),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 15)
  )

print(p_occurrence)

# ---- Save plot and table ---------------------------------------------------
ggsave(
  filename = file.path(out_dir, "FigureSx_vOTU_occurrence_infant.png"),
  plot     = p_occurrence,
  width    = 8,
  height   = 5,
  dpi      = 300
)

write.csv(
  occurrence_freq,
  file = file.path(out_dir, "FigureSx_vOTU_occurrence_infant_counts.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

# ---- Quick singleton summary (nice for Results text) ------------------------
singleton_stats <- votu_occurrence %>%
  summarise(
    total_vOTUs = n(),
    singletons = sum(n_samples == 1),
    pct_singletons = 100 * singletons / total_vOTUs
  )

print(singleton_stats)

```


```{r}
library(patchwork)

p_full <- p_occurrence

p_zoom <- ggplot(occurrence_freq %>% filter(n_samples >= 2),
                 aes(n_samples, n_vOTUs)) +
  geom_col(fill = "grey30") +
  labs(
    x = "Number of infant samples (≥2)",
    y = "Number of vOTUs",
    title = "Zoom excluding singletons"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 16) +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(face="bold", hjust=0.5))

p_combo <- p_full / p_zoom + plot_layout(heights = c(1, 1))

print(p_combo)

ggsave(
  filename = file.path(out_dir, "FigureSx_vOTU_occurrence_infant_full_plus_zoom.png"),
  plot     = p_combo,
  width    = 8, height = 9, dpi = 300
)
```





```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)

occ_bin <- votu_occurrence %>%
  mutate(bin = case_when(
    n_samples == 1            ~ "1",
    n_samples == 2            ~ "2",
    n_samples >= 3 & n_samples <= 5   ~ "3–5",
    n_samples >= 6 & n_samples <= 10  ~ "6–10",
    n_samples >= 11 & n_samples <= 20 ~ "11–20",
    n_samples >= 21 & n_samples <= 50 ~ "21–50",
    n_samples >= 51                    ~ "51+"
  )) %>%
  count(bin, name = "n_vOTUs") %>%
  mutate(bin = factor(bin, levels = c("1","2","3–5","6–10","11–20","21–50","51+")))

p_binned <- ggplot(occ_bin, aes(bin, n_vOTUs)) +
  geom_col(fill = "grey30") +
  scale_y_log10() +
  labs(
    x = "Number of infant samples in which each vOTU is detected (binned)",
    y = "Number of vOTUs (log10)",
    title = "Frequency of vOTU occurrence across infant samples"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 16) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face="bold", hjust=0.5),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 0, hjust = 0.5)
  )

print(p_binned)

```

```{r}
cdf_df <- occurrence_freq %>%
  arrange(n_samples) %>%
  mutate(cum_prop = cumsum(n_vOTUs) / sum(n_vOTUs))

p_cdf <- ggplot(cdf_df, aes(n_samples, cum_prop)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent_format(accuracy = 1)) +
  labs(
    x = "Number of infant samples",
    y = "Cumulative fraction of vOTUs",
    title = "Cumulative distribution of vOTU occurrence across infant samples"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 16) +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(face="bold", hjust=0.5))

print(p_cdf)
```

```{r}
p_cdf_step <- ggplot(cdf_df, aes(n_samples, cum_prop)) +
  geom_step(linewidth = 1) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent_format(accuracy = 1), limits = c(0,1)) +
  labs(
    x = "Number of infant samples in which each vOTU is detected",
    y = "Cumulative fraction of vOTUs",
    title = "Cumulative distribution of vOTU occurrence across infant samples"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 16) +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(face="bold", hjust=0.5))

print(p_cdf_step)
```


```{r}
# ---- Save plot and table ---------------------------------------------------
ggsave(
  filename = file.path(out_dir, "p_cdf.png"),
  plot     = p_cdf,
  width    = 8,
  height   = 5,
  dpi      = 300
)
```

```{r}
# cola (sin singletons) en escala lineal
tail_df <- occurrence_freq %>% filter(n_samples >= 2)

p_tail <- ggplot() +
  # barra de singletons
  geom_col(
    data = occurrence_freq %>% filter(n_samples == 1),
    aes(x = n_samples, y = n_vOTUs),
    fill = "grey30", width = 0.9
  ) +
  # cola como línea/puntos (para que se vea sin aplastar)
  geom_line(
    data = tail_df,
    aes(x = n_samples, y = n_vOTUs),
    linewidth = 1
  ) +
  geom_point(
    data = tail_df,
    aes(x = n_samples, y = n_vOTUs),
    size = 2
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Number of infant samples in which each vOTU is detected",
    y = "Number of vOTUs",
    title = "vOTU occurrence across infant samples (singletons + tail)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 16) +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(face="bold", hjust=0.5))

print(p_tail)
```
